epochs.description: Number of passes over the training images.

batch_size.description: How many images the network looks at before each weight update.

learning_rate.description: Step size for each weight update; too high and the loss jumps about.

weight_decay.description: Penalty on large weights; higher values regularise.

early_stopping_patience.description: Stop when validation has not improved for this many epochs; 0 disables.

seed.description: Random seed for the model (the data split has its own frozen seed).

augment.description: Randomly flip and shift training images so the model sees more variety.

dropout.description: Fraction of activations dropped during training; higher regularises.

pretrained.description: Start from ImageNet weights (needs the network) or from scratch.

freeze_backbone.description: Train only the final layer, keeping the pretrained features fixed.
